Forces a specific package manager to be used. By default, Remotion will auto-detect the package manager based on your lockfile.<br />Acceptable values are `npm`, `yarn`, `pnpm`, `bun` and `nub`.

## CLI flag

```text
--package-manager <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion upgrade`](/docs/cli/upgrade)
- [`remotion add`](/docs/cli/add)
